{{Quote|My mission to the twelfth moon of Yout has failed.|KRONOS-327, to Ziro the Hutt|audio=Yout-TCW.flac|<ref name="TCW" />}}
The '''mission to Yout 12''' was a mission undertaken by [[KRONOS-327/Legends|KRONOS-327]] on [[Yout 12]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==The mission==
{{Quote|After all these years, my most ''trusted'' of assassins has finally failed.|Ziro the Hutt|audio=KRONOS327Failed-TCWf.flac|<ref name="TCW" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|358|Yout 12}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] sent the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[KRONOS-327/Legends|KRONOS-327]] on a mission to [[Yout 12]] in order to [[Assassin/Legends|eliminate]] a rival [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]].<ref name="TVG" />

However, the [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droid]] botched the mission on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]],<ref name="CSWE" /> in the [[Qiilura sector/Legends|Qiilura sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|O Ziro the Hutt, Master of the Hutt Clan on seven systems, I am sorry, Your Highness. It will not happen again.''"<br />"''I know. Take him away, and use him for spare parts!|KRONOS-327 and Ziro the Hutt|audio=KRONOS327SpareParts-TCWf.flac|<ref name="TCW" />}}
[[File:KRONOS-327.png|thumb|left|270px|KRONOS-327 reports his failure to Ziro the Hutt]]
Eventually, KRONOS-327 returned to [[Ziro's Palace/Legends|Ziro's Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to report his failure,<ref name="TCW" /> believing that he could complete the mission if given another chance.<ref name="CE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

However, Ziro the Hutt decided that KRONOS-327 was no longer useful and activated a secret control that neutralized the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] weapons.<ref name="TVG" /> The [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] then ordered that the droid be dismantled and used for spare parts.<ref name="TCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mission to Yout 12 was first mentioned in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'',<ref name="TVG" /> just prior to the release of the film [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']].<ref name="TCW" />
